articles.title: Hacker behind 2022 GTA VI leaks pleads guilty
articles.essence: Arion Kurtaj, a member of the Lapsus$ cybercrime group who leaked 90 videos of Grand Theft Auto VI in 2022 and hacked other big companies, pleaded guilty on Monday, according to the UK's Crown Prosecution Service (CPS). articles.title: Tech leaders are convinced that Jensen Huang’s exit was a plot against him
articles.essence: Jensen Huang's stunning resignation from Nvidia after more than 33 years has sent shockwaves throughout the tech industry. Now prominent figures are calling for Huang's reinstatement, and many are also hopping on board with a theory spreading throughout Silicon Valley: that the scandal is the result of a plot against the former CEO.

articles.title: United Airlines system outage disrupts departures just days after the big ground stop
articles.essence: Less than a week after an issue with air traffic control communications and radar caused the FAA to halt takeoffs nationwide, United Airlines departing flights are being disrupted by an outage. At 6:13PM ET, United said the problem has been fixed: Earlier today we experienced a technology-related issue that impacted some departing flights.
